Our promises

What each promisemeans in practice.

01

Quality Sourcing

We choose produce carefully at the source, so what reaches you matches what we agreed.

  • Produce selected from growers and processors we work with
  • Grades and sizes confirmed with you before the order
  • Lots inspected before they are packed
02

Reliable Service

Clear answers, steady communication and follow-through on every enquiry.

  • One phone and WhatsApp number for every question
  • Quotes that state product, grade, packing and quantity
  • Updates at each stage, from packing to dispatch
03

Careful Packing

Each product is packed to suit how it travels, so it arrives in good condition.

  • Packing chosen for each product: fresh, dried or compressed
  • Your own packing or labelling needs discussed up front
  • Packed lots checked against the order
04

Timely Delivery

We plan every order around your timeline and keep you informed along the way.

  • Delivery window agreed when the order is confirmed
  • Dispatch planned around your destination
  • You hear from us if anything changes

Working with us

From enquiry todispatch.

Four simple steps, so you always know where your order stands.

  1. Send your enquiryTell us the product, quantity, packing and destination by form, phone or WhatsApp.
  2. Get a clear quoteWe reply with availability, grade, packing and price for your order.
  3. Confirm the orderWe agree the specifications and delivery window together, in writing.
  4. Packed and dispatchedYour order is checked, packed and dispatched, with updates along the way.
